lightningcss.reason: Vite's CSS minifier, a tool of development: it comes with vite, which Vitest requires, never ships and puts nothing of its own into the package; its builds for each platform come with it (R08 in skill-map's docs/decisions.md)

axe-core.reason: The checker of accessibility the browser tests run, a tool of development: it never ships and puts nothing of its own into the package, and the package is built, run and checked otherwise without it (R10 in skill-map's docs/decisions.md)
